रामयण के ट्रेलर पर फिदा होने वाले नीतीश भारद्वाज अब फिल्म के खिलाफ हो गए हैं।

महाभारत में कृष्ण का किरदार निभाने वाले नीतीश ने फिल्म देखते ही अपना स्टैंड बदल लिया है।
उनका आरोप है कि फिल्म में रावण को न्यायप्रिय और निष्पक्ष दिखाकर इसके नैतिक ढांचे को बदल दिया गया है।
नीतीश का कहना है कि सिर्फ बेहतरीन VFX से इस महाकाव्य की मूल भावनाओं और दार्शनिक गहराई की जगह नहीं ली जा सकती।
उन्होंने सोशल मीडिया से अपनी वह पुरानी पोस्ट भी हटा दी है जिसमें उन्होंने फिल्म को ऑस्कर मिलने की बात कही थी।
नीतीश के मुताबिक यह फिल्म भारत के गौरवशाली इतिहास और आध्यात्मिक मूल्यों को गलत तरीके से पेश करती है।

क्या आपको भी लगता है कि फिल्म में रावण का चित्रण गलत है या नीतीश भारद्वाज का विरोध बेमतलब है? 🧐🎬🤔

ctx.title: Mahabharat star Nitish Bharadwaj goes from predicting Oscar for Ramayana to criticising it, says film misrepresents India's history
ctx.summary: After watching Ramayana, Mahabharat actor Nitish Bharadwaj criticised the film's portrayal of Ravana.
ctx.text:
Actor Nitish Bharadwaj , who played Lord Krishna in BR Chopra's iconic 1988 television series Mahabharat , was among the first celebrities to praise Ramayana after its trailer was released. The actor even predicted that the film would win an Oscar. However, Nitish changed his stance after watching the film and went on to criticise the Ranbir Kapoor-starrer, saying it misrepresents India's history and heritage.
The actor expressed his disappointment with the makers' portrayal of Ravana, played by Yash, as a fair and socially just character. According to him, this changes the moral framework of the epic.
He wrote on Instagram, "The Ramayan is not just a story. It is deeply rooted in the civilizational and spiritual consciousness of Sanatan Bharat. Its heroes, heroine and antagonist are integral to the values and message of this Mahakavya. Their character and significance cannot be casually redefined. Mahavishnu took the Ram Avatar to uphold Dharma, parampara and establish Maryada. By presenting Ravan as an exceptionally liberal, socially just and fair figure, the film, in my view, alters the moral framework of the Ramayan and undermines the very purpose of avataar."
Nitish also pointed out that impressive visual effects cannot substitute for the core values of the epic. He further revealed that he was withdrawing his earlier social media post in which he had praised the film after watching its trailer.
He wrote, "I am deeply upset and disappointed with this film. I withdraw my earlier post about it. I cannot find a single good word to say about it. A spectacle of VFX can never substitute for the core values, philosophical depth and spiritual essence of this Mahakavya. This film, in my opinion, does not deserve to represent Indian cinema internationally when its narrative misrepresents Bharat's history, heritage and core spiritual values."
A post shared by Nitish Bharadwaj (@nitishbharadwaj.krishna)
Earlier, after watching the film's trailer, Nitish had taken to social media to praise the makers and predict a major international recognition for the film. He had written, "100% Oscar for Best Foreign Film. Nitesh Tiwari is Bharat's next gift to world cinema after Satyajit Rai and Shekhar Kapoor. Tens of awards for Production Design and DOP. Wonderful period creation using VFX and AI. Thanks to the great music maestro Hans Zimmer for collaborating with Indian cinema. Ranbir now at par with Ranveer as the next two unbeatable Dhurandhars. Yash — welcome to global cinema."
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the two-part epic features music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The first instalment was released in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part scheduled to arrive in 2028.
